title: Escape from Fortress Lugohm
description:
Aisha is a happy-go-lucky thief girl. 

She was on her way home after having completed a mission from the guild.

However, on her way back, she was caught by the infamous Count Lugohm and his guards.

What will become of Aisha?

Will Aisha be able to escape from the impregnable Fortress Lugohm?

Find out in this Stealth Survival RPG brought to you in native English!

Features

• • A Stealth Survival RPG Experience

• Assassination System

• Multiple Difficulty Levels

• And Multiple Methods to Escape!
description_short: Aisha was on her way home after having completed a mission for the guild. But on her way back, she was caught by the infamous Count Lugohm. Will she be able to escape from the clutches of Count Lugohm? Find out in this Stealth Survival RPG!
